# Salisbury General

> A software engineering consultancy run by Joe Salisbury, offering senior engineering help across AI, cloud-native, and Kubernetes — from engineering management to hands-on development.

Salisbury General is how Joe Salisbury helps teams ship things that matter. Two sides: engineering management (hiring, structuring teams, leading an engineering department) and practical, hands-on development (building with AI, shipping cloud-native infrastructure with Kubernetes, engineering things the right way).

## Consulting

- [Call](https://salisburygeneral.com/#consulting): One hour on whatever's pressing — a technical question, a personnel decision, or a second opinion before you commit.
- [Sprint](https://salisburygeneral.com/#consulting): One to three focused days on a specific thing — a prototype, a hiring plan, or a technical problem that needs solving now.
- [Retainer](https://salisburygeneral.com/#consulting): A standing block of time each week (from 4 hrs/week) for teams that want someone senior in the loop.

## Notes

- [Substack](https://salisburygeneral.substack.com/): New things Joe is trying out, deep technology dives, and works in progress.
